schema.name: Person
schema.purpose_statement: One person the owner has added. The hash coordinate person_id is the hash of node_key.

field_descriptions.person_id: Stable id of this person: the hash of node_key.
field_descriptions.node_key: Node key of this person. person_id is its hash.
field_descriptions.contact_code: Code another person uses to add this contact.
field_descriptions.added_at: When this person was added, RFC 3339.
